likely.

Centralia, Bernard, Bankston, and Graf around 755 AM CDT.

properties.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest
floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a
mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter
and protect yourself from flying debris.

This line of thunderstorms is capable of producing tornadoes and
widespread significant wind damage. Do not wait to see or hear the
tornado. For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest
floor of a building.

For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is occurring.

* WHERE...Southwestern Somerset County in south central
Pennsylvania...

* WHEN...Until 1130 AM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Numerous roads
remain closed due to flooding.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 825 AM EDT, local law enforcement reported flooding in the
warned area.  Between 3 and 5 inches of rain have fallen.
- A Flood Watch remains in effect through 5 AM Wednesday.
Additional heavy rainfall is possible.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Meyersdale, Ursina, New Centerville, Mount Davis, Rockwood,
Confluence, Salisbury, Garrett, Addison, Wellersburg, Casselman,
Callimont and Seven Springs.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

In hilly terrain there may be low water crossings. Do not attempt to
cross flooded roads. Find an alternate route.
